code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows severe hypoxemia and acidemia (low O₂ saturation, low pO₂, low pH), leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, mild thrombocytopenia, microcytic anemia features, elevated D-dimer, ferritin, LDH, CRP, INR, and alkaline phosphatase. These findings suggest acute systemic inflammation, possible infection or sepsis, and significant respiratory compromise. Immediate clinical evaluation is recommended.
